about_the_game:
The oceans are in trouble. Wildlife is fighting for survival. Hope feels like a distant memory – unless someone dares to make a change.

Pollucean is a storydriven adventure game with management & automation elements. The game is set in a world where trash has flooded the sea and most ocean inhabitants have vanished. Enter Dash - a marine biologist who has taken it upon themselves to clean up the oceans and bring back the sea life. Along their journey to reach this goal, they learn how to recycle collected trash, create their own equipment, meet quirky characters and unravel the true origin of this worlds pollution.

Save the seas!

Clean the oceans by picking up floating trash. After a long diving session you need to decide whether you sell or recycle your collections.

Explore the depths!

Unlock many different diving spots with even more secrets to uncover.

Create your own equipment!

Upgrade your equipment and unlock different types of modification - from boosting your swim speed to your maximum carryweight.

Automate recycling!

Build your very own recycling factory and automate its workflow. Experiment with different trash and recycling machines to create valuable materials.

What begins as a personal mission to restore the sea soon unravels into a larger conspiracy - one that forces Dash to ask: Can one person really make a difference... or is the ocean already lost?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: SteamOS 3.0 (based on Arch Linux)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 3200G or Intel Core i5-4570
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Vega 8 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.14 Mojave or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics or AMD Radeon R9 M370X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
